NEAR's fee burn plus Intents buybacks equal 12.0% of what it mints. Break-even is 8.4x away.

Models

Four models, each a few functions in run.py, each rebuilt by python3 run.py from the cached data with no network. Their outputs are in out/results.json.

Flow identity

Mint and burn per epoch from total_supply in block headers, exact to the yoctoNEAR. The buyback gain is a balance change. No parameters.

fetch.py: fetch_epoch, checked by run.py: load and verify.py

QuantityDefinition
mintsupply(first) - supply(prev last) + burnt(first)
burnburnt(first) + supply(first) - supply(last)
payback(burn + buyback gain) / mint
multiplemint / (burn + buyback gain)

Burn forecasters

Three models forecast NEAR burnt per epoch as 10%, 50% and 90% quantiles. Walk-forward backtest, 510 forecasts, up to 30 epochs ahead; each forecast uses only data before its date. Lower pinball loss is better. The bands are too narrow: they hold about two-thirds of outcomes against a nominal 80%.

Window bands

For a window of the next N epochs: the last N-epoch value, scaled by the 5% to 95% range of how much consecutive windows have differed. The table is how often that procedure, run at earlier dates on data available then, contained the outcome. Nominal coverage is 90%.

Break-even levers

Payback scales with Intents volume and with the share of gross Intents fees that reaches the buyback account, and inversely with the issuance rate. Two of the three are governance decisions. HSP-029, passed by NEAR's House of Stake on 2026-11-02 and awaiting ratification, would lower maximum issuance to 1.6% a year.

Forecast rounds: the chain scores them

Each round was frozen before the epochs it describes existed, and its hash is anchored in Bitcoin. run.py refuses a round that is not exactly what the code derives from the data up to its height, so neither the numbers nor the method can be edited afterwards. Historically the payback band has held 82% of the time, so an occasional miss is expected even when the model is right, and a pass near the bounds is weak support.

The case, both ways

The full argument, with what would change our mind, is in THESIS.md.

For

  • The flow is on chain and exact. 9,922 NEAR a day reach the buyback account, against 829 burnt.
  • It comes from one contract. 2979 of 2996 recent transfers were sent by intents.near.
  • A separate pipeline agrees. DefiLlama gives 13,589 NEAR a day for all revenue wallets; balances read from chain give 13,984.
  • Capture is a lever. The buyback account receives about 23% of gross Intents fees. All of it, at today's volume, would be 49% of issuance.
  • Issuance is a lever in motion. At 1.6% a year the multiple is 5.3x at today's flows.

Against

  • Buybacks are not burns. The NEAR sits in a multisig account. Supply does not fall and the holders can spend it.
  • Payback has been falling. From a peak of 16.5% on 2026-09-19 to 12.0%.
  • NEAR Intents is not growing. Over a year, daily volume is 1.02x and gross fees 0.75x (DefiLlama).
  • The flow is concentrated. One application supplies 92% of the payback.
  • The balance has fallen before. 10,283 NEAR left the account in 1 of 663 epochs.

Reproduce it

The result hash below covers every number on this page. If your run prints a different hash, the page and the data disagree.

Get the repository. Python 3.9 or later, no packages, no keys.

git clone https://github.com/nice-bills/Coverage && cd Coverage

Rebuild every number on this page from the cached chain data. Offline, under two seconds.

python3 run.py
RESULT sha256=2a3ce99539498d55e4b427116c454d924976109aa3e48805b6c4d87b3e201777

Self-test: scoring maths, data hashes, and refusal of a cache or a round with one value changed.

python3 test_run.py
SELFTEST PASS

Pick any seed. Random epochs are refetched from mainnet and must match the cache exactly.

python3 verify.py 3 12345
VERIFY seed=12345 PASS (3/3 epochs match the chain, 6 blocks checked against their parents)

Fetch the epochs that closed since and score the forecast rounds.

python3 fetch.py --epochs 45 && python3 run.py
LEDGER round-<height>-h05.json: 5/5 epochs closed -> PASS or FALSIFIED
